title: 第15 章 翼人一族的起源第 16章 造池进化
slug: 西幻从鹰人部落到天使帝国
content_zh:
说做便做。
姜尤先是回到驻地，宣布了危险解除的消息，然后让族人们准备好青铜工具，在天堂山的山腹处，找两处足以容纳泰坦和巨龙尸体的地方，挖上两个大坑！
他要把他们藏起来，长久利用。
然后，他便拿起青石，往泰坦和巨龙同归于尽的地方飞去。
当他再次赶到目的地。
两大半神生物的鲜血已不再流淌，半神的身躯非比寻常。
但他们的身下，依旧汇聚出了几洼金色的血液。
同时，因为光明和黑暗之力的难以共存。
两方血液相交织的地方发出滋滋的响声，像是什么东西在被不停的磨损，然后共同腐朽！
看到这一幕，姜尤舍弃了共浴泰坦与龙之血的想法。
但光明与黑暗、泰坦与巨龙总得选一个。
这时，他看了看自己的样子，觉得自己还是偏向于人形生物。
于是他便来到泰坦之血形成的那洼鲜血之池中，抱着青石一跃而下！
“啊！！”
只一瞬间，一股深入骨髓的痛感席卷全身，他感觉到自己的每一处皮肤和细胞都在燃烧！
就像是在回炉重造，将他的全身如同打造零件一般敲打，又有一股致命的暴烈之感，将他的血脉抽出来又按进去！
但很快，青石开始发出莹莹之光，一股清凉之感通达全身，暴烈感被消除，血脉变异平静下来。
姜尤只来得及松一口气，剧烈疼痛的如同下了十八层地狱的疼痛再次袭来。
痛，太痛了！
这一次，可没有湖水的稀释，他纯纯是泡在泰坦之血内。

在他的心神之外，系统的叮叮声不停响起！但他却没有精神去查看了。
就这般来回往复了三天三夜，当他感受不到痛觉的时候，只凭一股强横的意志撑起不屈的意识之时，洼地内的泰坦之血只剩下了十分之一，且光华尽去，如同凡物。
姜尤这才缓过来。
他先是检查了一下自己的身躯，发现自己的羽翼中，灰黑的羽毛全部褪去，替换上洁白的羽毛。
他的头发也全部转变为银色，除羽翼之外，包括面部在内，整个身体上的羽毛也全部褪去，露出俊美的脸庞和白皙的皮肤。
因为沐浴的是光明女泰坦的鲜血，他的魅力得到了极大的提升。
而令他最惊喜的地方，在于他的手爪和脚爪，已经完全转化为双手双脚，和前世的人类没有什么两样了。
拥有了人类一般的手脚，他能做的事情太多，且战斗力也大大提升！
这时，他才有空翻看系统面板。
content_en:
Just do it.
Jiang You first returned to the station, announced the news that the danger was over, and then asked the tribesmen to prepare bronze tools, find two places in the hinterland of Tiantang Mountain that were large enough to accommodate the bodies of Titans and dragons, and dig two large pits!
He wanted to hide them and use them for a long time.
Then, he picked up the bluestone and flew to the place where the Titan and the dragon died together.
When he arrived at his destination again.
The blood of the two demigod creatures no longer flows, and the bodies of the demigods are extraordinary.
But there were still pools of golden blood pooling under their bodies.
At the same time, because the power of light and darkness cannot coexist.
The place where the blood of the two parties intertwined made a sizzling sound, as if something was being constantly worn and then decayed together!
Seeing this scene, Jiang You gave up the idea of ​​bathing in the blood of titans and dragons together.
But you have to choose between light and darkness, titans and dragons.
At this time, he looked at himself and felt that he still preferred humanoid creatures.
So he came to the pool of blood formed by the Titan's blood, and jumped down holding the bluestone!
"Ah!!"
In just a moment, a pain that penetrated deep into the bone marrow swept through his body, and he felt that every part of his skin and cells was burning!
It was as if he was being rebuilt, beating his whole body like parts, and there was a deadly violent feeling as his blood was pulled out and pressed in again!
But soon, the bluestone began to emit a gleaming light, a cool feeling spread throughout the body, the violent feeling was eliminated, and the blood variation calmed down.
Jiang You only had time to breathe a sigh of relief when the severe pain, as if he had been sent to the eighteenth level of hell, hit him again.
It hurts, it hurts so much!
This time, there was no dilution from the lake water, he was purely soaked in the Titan's blood.
Outside of his mind, the system's beeps kept ringing! But he didn't have the energy to check.
He went back and forth like this for three days and three nights. When he felt no pain and only relied on a strong will to support his unyielding consciousness, only one-tenth of the Titan's blood in the depression was left, and the brilliance was gone, just like a mortal thing.
Jiang You finally came to his senses.
He first checked his body and found that all the gray and black feathers in his wings had faded and were replaced with white feathers.
His hair also turned all silver, and except for his wings, all the feathers on his body, including his face, also faded away, revealing his handsome face and fair skin.
Because he was bathed in the blood of the female titan of light, his charm was greatly enhanced.
What surprised him the most was that his hands and feet had completely transformed into hands and feet, no different from the humans in his previous life.
With human-like hands and feet, he can do so many things, and his combat effectiveness is greatly improved!
Only then did he have time to look at the system panel.
